reviewMethod: Compared the exact candidate and exact prior semantic source/config sets and verified that only deploy/server.go, deploy/server_test.go and scripts/ci/check-static-image.sh changed.
Compared pinned prior/current site build outputs and verified identical 106-file, 7-asset trees.
Ran the affected static-server Go tests, race tests, shell syntax/checker lint, production-delivery wiring check and a fresh linux/amd64 image build with the candidate digest as OCI revision.
Ran the strengthened static-image smoke against the fresh image and exercised empty-asset, multi-asset and failed-curl checker behavior with a deterministic mock harness.
Ran fresh Node 24.20.0/pnpm 11.24.0 component a11y, site browser, all-71 document-layout, site-page performance, bundle-budget, package-boundary and installed consumer checks.
limitations: This is a local exact-source delta review, not a full replacement for T29/T30/T32 and not a release-readiness or publication certificate.
The earlier Node 22.23.2 host-default runs were excluded; only logs beginning with Node 24.20.0 and pnpm 11.24.0 qualify here.
The generated site-page report retains sourceCommit unknown; source binding is supplied by the exact command log, source digest and byte-identity proof rather than relabeling that report.
The image was built for linux/amd64 on an arm64 host and emitted the expected platform warning during local smoke.
Manual assistive-technology certification, native WebMCP, human onboarding, model-answer accuracy, registry publication, deployment and production promotion remain unclaimed.
Historical nonblocking T30/T32 follow-ups remain retained in their prior exact-source packets; this delta does not silently close them.

verdict.summary: The only candidate semantic changes are the intended static-image cache checker/server changes. The site output is byte-identical to the exact prior source, the fresh static image passes the strengthened all-asset smoke and failure matrix, and the proportionate Node 24 regression checks pass. No new P0/P1/P2/P3 finding was observed.
